name: Connect Square Payments – WordPress Square Hosted Checkout for WooCommerce, Fluent Forms, CF7, WPForms, Pay Links & More
author: WPPayments

sections.description:
Connect Square Payments is the most reliable WooCommerce Square alternative that adds a professional Square payment gateway using Square Hosted Checkout.

Send buyers to Square’s secure hosted payment page — no card fields in your theme, no JavaScript conflicts, and a permanent fix for common payment nonce is missing or EMPTY_VALUE errors on WooCommerce checkout and Pay for Order pages.

Connect Square once and accept payments across your entire WordPress site:
* WooCommerce Square gateway (classic and Blocks checkout)
* Paid Memberships Pro (recurring memberships without WooCommerce Subscriptions)
* Fluent Forms, Contact Form 7 (CF7), and WPForms
* Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, MetForm, SureForms, and Forminator
* Square Payment Links (buttons for Gutenberg, Elementor, Beaver Builder, and shortcodes)
* Square Subscriptions for recurring billing

Live demo · Documentation · Support

Location stock demo

See Location stock — link WooCommerce products to Square locations and update inventory from one screen:

Square Hosted Checkout demo

Watch Square Hosted Checkout with WooCommerce in action:

Elementor payment links demo

See Square Payment Links with Elementor — Pay Now buttons and Square Hosted Checkout on a WordPress page:

Why merchants choose this plugin:

If you searched for Square payment for WordPress, you have probably seen on-site card fields break after a theme update or plugin conflict. Connect Square Payments is a no-code integration: connect Square once, enable the gateway, and send buyers to Square Hosted Checkout — no card form embedded in your theme.

  • Fix WooCommerce Square nonce error: Hosted checkout removes failure points like square-credit-card.js conflicts, session timeouts, and EMPTY_VALUE on Pay for Order pages.
  • Digital wallets included: Apple Pay, Google Pay, Cash App Pay, and Afterpay / Clearpay (BNPL) supported on Square’s page.
  • No extra platform fees: You pay Square’s normal processing rates only; no per-transaction plugin fee.
  • Reliable Inventory Sync: Simple SKU-based stock sync updates Square On hand when WooCommerce orders are paid.

Features

  • Hosted checkout — customers pay on Square’s secure page and return to your store.
  • Refunds from wp-admin — full or partial refunds directly on the WooCommerce order screen.
  • Pay for Order links — email or copy a secure invoice payment link for unpaid orders.
  • Payment sync — automatically check pending orders and mark them paid without needing complex webhooks.
  • Customer sync — keep Square and WordPress customer directories in sync automatically.
  • Square Loyalty Rewards — earn points on all paid orders (Free); redeem at checkout (Premium).
  • 24/7 Support — dedicated help via email, WhatsApp, and the WordPress.org forum.

Premium features

Upgrade under Payments Square Connect → Pricing to unlock:
* Location stock — link products to specific Square locations for accurate inventory.
* Bulk Location stock admin — manage locations and stock levels for your entire catalog at once.
* Square gift cards at checkout.
* Loyalty reward redemption directly on the checkout page.
* Bi-directional inventory (Square → WooCommerce) for real-time stock updates.
* And many more — see Payments Square Connect → Pricing for the full Plus and Pro feature list.

Looking for Square on Odoo?

This plugin is for WordPress / WooCommerce. If you need a Square solution on Odoo instead — inventory sync, multi-location stock, Square Hosted Checkout, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Cash App Pay, Afterpay, and Square Terminal — use our free Odoo module Square Sync & Pay:

https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/18.0/odoo_square_all_in_one

Same team (WPPayments). No module subscription fee — you only pay Square’s normal processing rates.
sections.installation:
→ Getting started guide

  1. Activate Payments Square Connect.
  2. Open Payments Square Connect in the admin sidebar.
  3. Choose Sandbox or Live, sign in with Square, and save a location.
  4. Enable WooCommerce Square checkout, or your preferred form plugin integration.
sections.faq:
Payment nonce is missing — can hosted checkout fix it?

Yes. The payment nonce is missing error usually happens when Square’s on-site JavaScript cannot tokenize the card due to theme conflicts or caching. Connect Square Payments avoids on-site nonce generation entirely by using Square Hosted Checkout.

How is this different from the official WooCommerce Square plugin?

The official plugin embeds card fields in your checkout. This plugin uses Square Hosted Checkout (off-site), which is often more reliable for sites with complex themes or caching. We also support WPForms, Fluent Forms, and CF7 on the same connection.

Does this work with Apple Pay and Google Pay?

Yes. Enable digital wallets under Payments Square Connect → Checkout Settings. Buyers will see Apple Pay, Google Pay, Cash App Pay, and Afterpay on the Square payment page.

Does Square payment work in the USA, UK, and Australia?

Yes. Square payment and Square Hosted Checkout work for merchants in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, Ireland, France, Spain, and Japan.
